title.zh: 印尼加密交易所 Indodax 因网络攻击风险暂时暂停充提
title.en: Indonesia's Largest Crypto Exchange Indodax Suspends Deposits and Withdrawals Am

current_state.zh: Indonesian crypto exchange Indodax temporarily suspended user deposits and withdrawals after detecting a rise in attempted network attacks, stating that user assets remain safe with no unauthorized withdrawals or data breach found, and that services will resume once systems are verified secure.
current_state.en: Indonesian crypto exchange Indodax temporarily suspended user deposits and withdrawals after detecting a rise in attempted network attacks, stating that user assets remain safe with no unauthorized withdrawals or data breach found, and that services will resume once systems are verified secure.
